zh-CN.title: 设置提示与文档排版优化

sections.title: 配置操作提示
items: 将导出、导入和恢复默认配置的结果提示统一放在操作按钮右侧；优化窄窗口布局，让消息优先换行，避免将恢复按钮挤到下一行
导入和恢复默认配置使用简短的成功或失败提示，具体原因放入详情；恢复默认配置完成后关闭确认弹窗，直接显示操作结果
每条提示都可通过叉号关闭，新消息会替换旧消息并重新计时，一分钟后自动消失；其他设置保存成功不会提前清除提示

sections.title: 消息详情样式
items: 详情改用与其他帮助提示一致的主题浮层，通过悬停或键盘聚焦查看，并为可查看详情的文字增加虚线下划线
短详情按内容自适应宽度，长详情限制最大宽度并自动换行；窗口较窄时限制在可用空间内，过长内容可滚动查看

sections.title: 文档与回归测试
items: 重新排版中英文 README 顶部，统一居中标题、简介和语言切换入口，突出当前语言并保留另一语言的页面链接
补齐导入配置字段错误、输出触发器校验、更新失败和部分高风险命令警告的英文翻译，避免异常提示中英混杂
补充提示关闭、自动消失、消息替换、导入及恢复失败等回归测试，并验证正式版与 Dev 构建的相关行为

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。本次更新不改变导入导出格式，正式版与 Dev 仍可互相导入，数据仍各自独立。

en.title: Settings notifications and README layout improvements

sections.title: Configuration notifications
items: Show export, import, and Restore defaults results to the right of the action buttons; improve narrow layouts so messages wrap before pushing the restore button onto another row
Use concise success or failure messages for imports and Restore defaults, with explanations in the details; close the Restore defaults confirmation after the operation to show its result
Add a dismiss button to every notification; new messages replace old ones and restart the one-minute timer, while successful saves of other settings no longer clear the current notification early

sections.title: Message details
items: Use the same themed popover as other help tips for message details, available on hover or keyboard focus, with a dotted underline indicating additional details
Size short details to their content and wrap longer details within a maximum width; constrain popovers to the available space in narrow windows and allow long content to scroll

sections.title: Documentation and regression tests
items: Align the Chinese and English README headers with centered titles, introductions, and language links, highlighting the current language while linking to the other language page
Complete English translations for invalid configuration fields, output trigger validation, update failures, and several high-risk command warnings to prevent mixed-language error messages
Add regression coverage for notification dismissal, expiry, replacement, imports, and restore failures, and verify the related behavior in stable and Dev builds

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. The import and export formats are unchanged; stable and Dev can still import each other’s exports while keeping their data separate.
